headline: In the first half of the year, trade turnover between the KR and Kuban increased by 26 percent
summary: Trade turnover between Kyrgyzstan and the Kuban region of Russia increased by roughly 26 percent in the first half of the year. The figure was reported by a regional business development department official.
why: Trade flows between Central Asian economies and Russian regions indicate shifts in regional commerce and supply routes. Kyrgyzstan's trade growth is a key indicator for its small, trade-dependent economy.
original_headline: В первом полугодии товарооборот между КР и Кубанью увеличился на 26 процентов
